visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins at an outdoor playground during the daytime. Character A, wearing a blue button-down shirt and brown wig with vampire-like makeup, leans against a playground structure. Character B, with long dark hair and a gray hoodie, stands nearby. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) Character A is shown in a close-up biting a green apple; his expression shifts from confidence to discomfort as he winces. (3) The camera follows Character A to a street where he performs a dramatic martial arts pose towards a black car, his hands glowing red with digital effects. Character B looks on with a concerned expression. (4) Back at the playground, Character B holds a pink popsicle. Character A takes a bite and immediately reacts with extreme dental sensitivity, holding his cheek in pain as white line graphics radiate from his face. (5) Character A, now with visible vampire fangs, talks to Character B while standing in front of a tree. (6) A transition occurs to a bright studio setting. Character B presents two Sensodyne product boxes and tubes to the camera. This is followed by a graphic animation showing three tubes of Sensodyne 'Sensitivity & Gum' toothpaste. (7) Split-screen and close-up shots show Character B and Character A brushing their teeth, demonstrating the product usage. (8) Returning to the playground, Character A takes off his shirt to reveal a muscular prosthetic torso suit. (9) The final shot shows Character A playfully lunging toward Character B's neck on a park bench.
